operator: Argon ideas I (volume-clock %R), K (absorption bar), opening washout, dwell/knock count; operator 11/07: test everything regardless of odds
family: 4 hypotheses, alpha 0.05/4 = 0.0125 per hypothesis; critical t from scipy t.ppf(1-0.0125, df) one-sided on per-day means
data: ai_reports/warehouse/sip/DAY.npz, 120 sessions 2026-04-27..2026-10-15, regular-session 1-minute SIP bars. Universe per day = top 400 by prior-session dollar volume, $10-$500 at the 09:30 open (as in board_structure_family). Halves by date at the median scored session. Trades: buy at the open of the bar after the trigger bar, sell at the close of the 10th bar after entry, 6 bp round trip, one trigger per name per 30 minutes, entries 09:45-15:30 unless stated.

V1_volume_clock_pctR.definition: Cumulative volume restarts at 09:30 each day (RTH only, no pre-market, no overnight carry). Size = median daily volume of the previous 20 sessions (strictly earlier) / 100. A volume bar closes at the first minute whose cumulative volume reaches the next multiple of size; its O/H/L/C are taken over its minutes up to and including that crossing minute. At minute t only bars whose crossing minute is <= t are used. %R(21), ewm span 7 (live formulas, signals.py) on volume-bar closes/highs/lows; the time-clock version is the same on 1-minute bars. The %R state is carried forward to every minute (one value per minute). No trigger before 21 volume bars (21 minutes for the time clock) have completed in the session. At most ONE volume bar closes per minute. Overshoot carries over: the multiple counter advances by floor(cum/size) but only one bar is emitted. Bar k's minutes start at the minute after bar k-1's crossing minute (the first bar starts at 09:30). Daily volume for size = sum of RTH 1-minute bar volume from the same file over the previous 20 sessions.
V1_volume_clock_pctR.trigger: Smoothed %R was <= -80 at some point in the last 5 units of that clock (5 volume bars for the volume clock, 5 one-minute bars for the time clock) and is now >= -50. Evaluated at the close of minute t; entry is the open of t+1.
V1_volume_clock_pctR.controls: (a) same name, random minute in the same clock hour (+-30), 5 draws; (b) [coverage reported; if fewer than 100 volume-clock triggers have a match the (b) lift is NOT TESTED] the time-clock trigger, matched: for each volume-clock trigger the time-clock comparison uses the same name, same day, time-clock triggers within +-30 minutes, and the lift is also reported on non-overlapping triggers only; information cells: triggers in the volume clock only and in the time clock only; (c) condition-matched: a random minute, same name-day, same hour, where smoothed %R (volume clock) was <= -80 within the last 5 units but the rest of the trigger is absent.
V1_volume_clock_pctR.pass: ALL: net > 0 with t >= critical; > 0 in both halves; lift vs (a) and vs (c) > 0 in both halves with pooled t >= critical; lift vs the time-clock trigger (b) > 0 in both halves; pooled net > 0 after dropping the best 5 days and the 5 largest-P&L names; the binding 10 bp case; count rules in common.

K_absorption_bar.trigger: Measured at the close of bar t (no look-ahead): median volume and median range are over bars t-20..t-1 (20 bars required, so no trigger before 09:50; median volume > 0 and median range > 0 required). Volume(t) >= 3x median volume; range(t) <= 0.5x median range; low(t) is the lowest low of bars t-14..t; close in the upper half of bar t; the 15-bar return before the bar, close(t-1)/close(t-16) - 1, <= -30 bp.
K_absorption_bar.controls: (a) same-name random minute same hour, 5 draws; (b) same minute, a random universe stock with close(t-1)/close(t-16)-1 <= -30 bp and no volume/range condition; (c) same name-day, same hour, a minute with the -30 bp prior drop and a 15-bar low but not the volume/range condition.
K_absorption_bar.pass: as V1 with lifts vs (a), (b), (c) all > 0 in both halves and pooled t >= critical

W_opening_washout.trigger: Open = the open of the first 09:30 bar. Washout = the LOW of some bar from 09:30 to 09:44 is >= 100 bp below that open, AND the close of the 09:44 bar is still below the open (still under water at the end of the washout window). Trigger = the first bar from 09:45 to 10:30 that closes back above the open; entry at the next open (last possible entry 10:31). One per name per day. Exit at 10 bars, as in the common trade statement.
W_opening_washout.controls: (a) same name-day (a name that washed out), a random minute after the 09:44 bar and before 10:30 that is not the trigger and not inside the hold window, 5 draws (tests timing); (b) at the same minute m, a random universe stock that did NOT wash out (never 100 bp below its open in 09:30-09:44), was below its open at 09:44, and whose first close above its open in 09:45-10:30 is at m (the same cross, no washout); if fewer than 100 such controls exist overall the (b) lift is NOT TESTED. Both lifts required.
W_opening_washout.pass: as V1 with lifts vs (a) and (b) > 0 in both halves

D_dwell_knock.trigger: Level = highest high of bars t-30..t-3 (earliest trigger 10:00; 28 bars required). The bar that set the level counts as knock 1. A later knock is a bar in t-30..t-3 whose high is within 5 bp of the level, >= 2 bars after the previous knock, with the lowest low between the two knock bars at least 10 bp below the level. Trigger at the close of bar t when close(t) > level and knocks >= 3; entry at the next open. Fresh breakout only: also require close(t-1) <= level and close(t-2) <= level. The same rule applies to (b) control events.
D_dwell_knock.controls: (a) same-name random minute same hour, 5 draws; (b) same name, same day, any breakout bar (close > highest high of t-30..t-3) with knocks <= 1, within +-30 minutes of the trigger hour, dedupe applied, 5 draws averaged; (b) needs >= 100 control events overall or the lift is NOT TESTED (not a pass).
D_dwell_knock.pass: as V1; lift vs (b) mandatory in both halves

if_pass: A pass earns a result-skeptic review and a forward test on IEX, never a live change.

common.universe: As data line, plus: exclude ETFs/levered products (is_not_stock rule used in board_structure_family); prior session = the preceding weekday in the warehouse file list; a name-day needs 20 prior sessions in the warehouse; bars are RTH SIP 1-minute from the same file for every measure.
common.dedupe: Applied BEFORE controls are drawn. The first trigger per name is kept; the 30-minute clock restarts only from a kept trigger. Suppressed trigger bars and all bars inside any kept trade's 10-bar hold window are ineligible as control draws for that name-day.
common.seeds: Control draws use a seed = sha256(sym|day|label|k) (as in board_structure_family). A name-day with no eligible control minute contributes no control and no trigger to the lift. Lifts are computed on days that have both triggers and controls.
common.day_rules: Per-day means exclude days with no trigger (not counted as zero). Need >= 60 scored days with at least one trigger and >= 25 per half, plus >= 300 triggers and >= 100 per half, else UNDERPOWERED.
common.void: VOID if > 10% of triggers cannot get a control draw for controls (a) or (c) (coverage of (b) is reported, not a VOID test), or if the volume-bar size is undefined for > 10% of name-days, or if a unit test of the trigger on a planted series fails.
common.critical: Primary net-bp test uses t >= scipy t.ppf(1-0.05/4, days-1) (one-sided, family of 4). Lifts use the SAME family critical value, not 1.65.
common.information_cells: Descriptive only. They never promote a pass or change a verdict. A pass at an information cell and not at the primary cell is a FAIL. The primary cell is the value written in the trigger, not the best variant. Family size stays 4; information cells do not reduce the bar.
common.sip_only: A PASS is SIP-only until it replicates on warehouse/iex and in a forward IEX test; neither is a live change.
common.binding_cost: The 10 bp case is binding: net > 0 and lift > 0 at 10 bp, both halves.
common.trade: Entry bar = t+1 (buy at its open). Exit = close of bar t+10, so the hold spans 10 bars including the entry bar. Round trip 6 bp for the primary t; the 10 bp case is binding for net > 0 and lift > 0.
common.window: 'Same clock hour (+-30)' everywhere means minutes within +-30 of the trigger minute, within 09:45-15:30, satisfying the warm-up rule.
common.lift: Lift t = one-sided t on per-day means of (trigger net minus mean control net), df = days-1, over days that have both. Every lift in every hypothesis uses this test against the family critical value AND must be > 0 in both halves.
common.drop_rule: Drop the best 5 days and the 5 largest-P&L names TOGETHER, then recompute pooled net.
common.not_tested: If a hypothesis' mandatory (b) control has fewer than 100 matched events overall, its (b) lift is NOT TESTED and the verdict is UNDERPOWERED, never PASS. Verdict order: VOID, UNDERPOWERED (including NOT TESTED), FAIL, PASS.
common.count_dry_run: Before the full run the tool prints trigger counts per hypothesis and per half with no returns; a hypothesis below the count rule is reported UNDERPOWERED without computing returns.
common.transition: A trigger fires only at the first minute where its condition becomes true (a transition), not on every minute it stays true.
